material.acceptance_criteria: On a checkout whose only changes are under .gm/ or .agentplug-kv/ (tracked or untracked), writer_lock check returns ok with dirty=0 and those paths in runtime_ignored. A source file change still returns not_clean with dirty>0. Live witness: writer_lock check dispatch on /workspace/oscraft read from a session other than the resolver.
material.description: Live witness 1793301779807-55024-cdefec463c75ef43 (session verify-writer-lock-check-not-clean-on-clean-checkout) on /workspace/oscraft: writer_lock check returned not_clean with dirty=27, fetch ok, ahead=0 behind=0. Its dirty_paths include tracked .gm/ files (.gm/gm.db, .gm/turn-state.json, .gm/exec-spool/.status.json, .gm/prd/*.yml) and .agentplug-kv/ files. File to fix: /workspace/gm/gm-mcp/src/triage-verbs.js writerLock check branch. The GM_RUNTIME_UNTRACKED regex only drops untracked ?? lines under .gm/ .agentplug/ .agentplug-kv/, and runtimeIgnored only applies to submodule ' M' lines, so tracked parent .gm/ changes count as dirty. Fix: treat tracked modifications under .gm/ and .agentplug-kv/ as runtime, reported in runtime_ignored, not dirty.
